name: TFI Unplugged
description: Chris Evans returns to Channel 4 with his iconic show... but this time he's unplugged! Enjoy unfiltered conversations with the biggest stars and the latest bands performing intimate sets.

videos.title: Sam Ryder, Shreya Ghoshal, Jack Savoretti, Sindhu Vee, Gemma Arterton, Peter Capaldi and Cush Jumbo.
videos.overview: Sam Ryder, Shreya Ghoshal, Jack Savoretti, Sindhu Vee, Gemma Arterton, Peter Capaldi and Cush Jumbo.

videos.title: Olivia Munn, Kris Marshall, Hard-Fi, Emma Laird
videos.overview: Guests include Olivia Munn, Kris Marshall, Hard-Fi and Emma Laird, and there's archive footage of Paul McCartney, Peter O'Toole, INXS and Prince

videos.title: KSI, Lenny Henry, Peter Capaldi, Cush Jumbo, Dodgy
videos.overview: Chris Evans presents chat and music, featuring KSI, Lenny Henry, Peter Capaldi, Cush Jumbo, Dodgy and American wrestler Big Show. There's also archive footage of Eurythmics, No Doubt, Pet Shop Boys and Robbie Williams

videos.title: Chris O'Dowd, Kelly Reilly, Cole Hauser, Kirstie Allsopp, Phil Spencer, Boo Radleys
videos.overview: Chris Evans is joined by Chris O'Dowd, Yellowstone's Kelly Reilly and Cole Hauser, Kirstie Allsopp and Phil Spencer, and the Boo Radleys. Plus, archive footage of Elton John, Tom Jones, and Rod Stewart

videos.title: Bob Odenkirk, Danny Dyer, Emilia Clarke, Nigel Ng, Tom Ogden, Joe Donovan, Gary Lightbody
videos.overview: Chris Evans presents more chat and music, featuring Bob Odenkirk, Danny Dyer, Emilia Clarke, Nigel Ng, Tom Ogden and Joe Donovan from Blossoms, and Gary Lightbody.

videos.title: Tom Davis, Tom Fletcher, Uncle Pappy
videos.overview: Chris Evans presents more chat and music, featuring Tom Davis, Tom Fletcher and Uncle Pappy. And from the archive, Kylie! Dolly! Noel! And Damon!

videos.title: Richard E Grant, Claire Foy, Shania Twain, Kiefer Sutherland, Esther Perel, Inspiral Carpets and Kyle Falconer
videos.overview: Chris's guests are Richard E Grant, Claire Foy, Shania Twain, Kiefer Sutherland, Esther Perel, Inspiral Carpets and Kyle Falconer

videos.title: Michael Fassbender, Damian Lewis, Ed Gamble, Joanne McNally, Beth Mead, Richard Bacon
videos.overview: Chris Evans is joined by Michael Fassbender, Damian Lewis, Ed Gamble, Joanne McNally, Beth Mead and Richard Bacon. To mark the beginning of the World Cup, he also has archive footage of Frank Skinner and David Baddiel.

videos.title: Jack Whitehall, Dawn French, Emmanuel Petit, Peter Crouch, Steve Coogan, Patrick Wilson, Haircut 100
videos.overview: Chris's guests are Jack Whitehall, Dawn French, Emmanuel Petit, Peter Crouch, Steve Coogan, Patrick Wilson and Haircut 100

videos.title: Wolfhard, Ben Platt, Aziz Ansari and Linda Perry, Jack Charlton, Ant and Dec, Jamiroquai, Toploader and Pet Shop Boys.
videos.overview: Chris Evans presents his iconic show with guests Finn Wolfhard, Ben Platt, Aziz Ansari and Linda Perry. From the TFI archives: Jack Charlton, Jamiroquai and Pet Shop Boys.

videos.title: Joe Lycett, Edward Norton, Catherine Laga'aia
videos.overview: Chris Evans presents his iconic show, with guests Joe Lycett, Edward Norton and Catherine Laga'aia. And from the TFI archives, Justin Bieber, George Best and Cheryl.

videos.title: Brandon Flowers, Jesse Tyler Ferguson, Professor Brian Cox, The Courteeners, The Florentenes
videos.overview: Chris's guests are Brandon Flowers, Jesse Tyler Ferguson, Professor Brian Cox, Courteeners, Florentenes and, from the TFI archive, Hugh Grant, Take That, and Baddiel & Skinner & The Lightning Seeds

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Chris presents his iconic show, with guests Vanessa Williams, Al Murray, tennis star Arthur Fery, Fabien Frankel and The Blossoms And from the archive, Christina Aquilera.
